summary: Probe and download public media, or collect links in draft groups and start locked ZIP packages. Account-scoped files expire automatically; tools return immediately.

tools.name: tool_vid_probe
tools.purpose: Inspect public media and its unblocked download options

tools.name: tool_vid_download
tools.purpose: Queue a download and return a job id immediately

tools.name: tool_vid_status
tools.purpose: Poll your job and get a fresh signed link

tools.name: tool_vid_listFiles
tools.purpose: List your unexpired files with fresh signed links

tools.name: tool_vid_package
tools.purpose: Create a draft group, add/remove media, or start and lock its ZIP download

tools.name: tool_vid_packages
tools.purpose: List your groups or inspect package progress, item failures and fresh ZIP links

params.name: url
params.description: Full public http(s) link to a video, music track, image or single photo post (TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest).

params.name: url
params.description: Full public http(s) link to a video, music track, image or single photo post (TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest).

params.name: preset
params.description: Unblocked preset from probe; use photos for images or photo carousels (ZIP).

params.name: action
params.description: create, add, remove or start. Start permanently locks the media list.

params.name: package_id
params.description: Required except for create; returned by create or packages.

params.name: name
params.description: Required for create; group name of 1 to 150 characters.

params.name: urls
params.description: Required for add; comma-separated public URLs. Percent-encode commas inside URLs.

params.name: preset
params.description: Unblocked preset shared by added links; use photos for images.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Required for remove; media item id from packages.

params.name: package_id
params.description: Optional id to inspect one group; omit to list your groups.

workflow.explanation: Inspect the URL and choose an unblocked preset.
Start the download; retain its job_id.
Poll until done or error, then open the signed download_url.
Find earlier unexpired files or renew a download link.
For a package: create a named group, add URLs with chosen presets, then start. The accepted start permanently locks membership.
Inspect group items and failures; completed packages include one ZIP of successful downloads. Status also accepts the package job_id.
